title: Loader Program Consolidation
summary: Consolidated OpenDRIVE loader entry points onto the canonical loader and identity guards; deprecated redundant/thin or prototype programs.

hardening: StrictCarlaOpendriveGate preflight (_preflight_xodr) before any CARLA call
short-timeout readiness probe with long-timeout restore

deprecated.reason: Thin wrapper around the canonical loader that hardcoded 127.0.0.1:2000 and used emoji stdout. Now delegates to load_opendrive_world_from_file with fallback disabled; kept for backward compatibility until no callers remain.
remaining_references: ultimate_pipeline/run_full_test.py (docstring only; step 5 switched to start_carla_load_xodr)
worktrees/ and submission/ snapshot copies (not production callers)

deprecated.reason: One-off hardening prototype whose behavior was ported into the canonical loader + identity guards. Its EXPECTED_CANDIDATE points to the superseded source candidate (ff2a05e7...) rather than the repaired candidate (80ebb005...). Retained only as evidence.

kept_as_canonical_entry_point.reason: Full-featured CLI (autostart CARLA, configurable host/port/timeout/retries/wait) delegating to load_opendrive_world_from_file with fallback disabled; now the loader used by ultimate_pipeline/run_full_test.py step 5.
